title: EC31005: Rf And Microwave Engineering
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Pre-requisites: EC21006 S-matrix: representation, properties, shift in
reference planes, generalized S-matrix; wave propagation in planar lines:
design, effective dielectric constant, attenuation, dispersion, power-handling
capability; lumped elements and their design; passive components: operation and
S-matrices of resonators/cavities, directional couplers, power
splitters/combiners, filters; non-reciprocal components: isolators and
circulators; microwave sources: tube type, transistor amplifier and oscillator
design, Gunn oscillator; microwave systems.
